details:
ShiftSeed is a crop-rotation decision-support website that helps farmers respond to changing rainfall, temperature, and soil-moisture conditions. It combines NASA Earth-observation data with local soil information, crop characteristics, irrigation availability, and farmer priorities to compare three-season rotation strategies through interactive what-if scenarios.

Its Weak-Link Detector identifies the most vulnerable crop in a rotation, explains the risk, and uses the Rotation Repair Engine to recommend a stronger alternative. Built using React, JavaScript, Tailwind CSS, Supabase, and Netlify, ShiftSeed makes complex environmental data understandable and actionable while supporting, rather than replacing, farmer judgment and local agricultural expertise.
